llm.why_zero: No generative LLM is called. Explanations are deterministic templates filled with computed numbers and verbatim note text; verdicts come from deterministic validation.

embeddings.tokens_note: Counted with the model's own tokenizer (includes special tokens).

call_volume_design: One retrieval query per numerically anomalous route-week (not per shipment); all queries embedded in a single batch.
measurement_caveats: runtime_seconds is wall-clock on the machine that produced this file.
